history.summary: A 597-unit 2017 leasehold in Tampines with a large 915sqft 2BR at $1,421 psf — ~6% below the URA median ($1,517) — backed by 201 transactions and a steady 5.13% CAGR. The Tampines Regional Centre and future Tampines West DTL access give a real OCR catalyst, but the 1.4km MRT distance and MCC Land's mixed build-quality reputation hold it to a Buy rather than higher.
history.rating_rationale: 915sqft 2BR at $1.30M / $1,421 psf is ~6% below median PSF ($1,517) with a deep 201-transaction record and 5.13% CAGR (reliable). The generous size suits a wide buyer pool (couples to small families), and 597 units provide good liquidity. Tampines Regional Centre amenities (waterfront, Quarry Park) and DTL Tampines West proximity support demand. Held back by ~1.4km MRT walk and MCC Land's 'beware quality' reputation. On frontier, MMR 1550 / score 800. Below-median entry plus size efficiency drive the Buy.

history.summary: Fairly-priced 527sqft 1BR in an OCR D18 development - asking PSF sits right at the project's verified recent transaction range, so it is market-priced rather than a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,438 psf matches the project's reality: verified 527sqft 1BR transactions over the past 12 months ran $1,356-$1,593 psf (avg ~$1,490), with the latest (17 Dec 2025) at $1,570 psf and two Dec-2025 sales at $758,888 and $828,000. The -0.8% psf-vs-cohort (13 txns, a decent cohort) accurately tags this as at-market, not cheap, so there is no entry discount to underwrite. Positives: D18 is OCR (better forward baseline ~+4% per v3.4), 2018 completion leaves ~91 yrs lease, and 5.13% 5yr CAGR (201 txns) is a respectable but forward-discounted story. Negative: MCC Land build draws recurring quality caveats in forums. Net: a solid, liquid OCR rental unit but priced in line with peers - no margin of safety, hence Neutral.
red_flags: No entry discount - asking PSF is essentially at the project's recent transaction average
MCC Land build quality draws recurring caveats in owner/forum reviews
Tampines Street 86 location is a moderate walk to MRT
catalysts: OCR/Tampines rental demand and regional-centre employment support tenancy
Deep, liquid 1BR cohort (13 same-size txns) makes exit straightforward
Tampines North MRT (DTL) accessibility in the broader area
